correctness.rationale: For even r>=2, the order-two orbifold branch generators of a genus-one quotient give H_1(Gamma)=Z^2+ (Z/2)^(r-1), and the surjective cover character has torsion kernel (Z/2)^(r-2). The five-term group homology exact sequence identifies this kernel with H_1(C) coinvariants. A free elliptic two-torsion translation makes the surface diffeomorphic to S^1 times the deck-involution mapping torus. Integral Wang and Kunneth give H_1(S)=Z^4+T, H_2(S)=Z^6+T, H_3(S)=Z^4, H_4(S)=Z; integral UCT places T in H^2(S),H^3(S). Smooth codimension-three blow-up and the integral blow-up formula place T in H^4 through H^7(X), nowhere else. Poincare duality pairings and exact independent polynomial bookkeeping check the free ranks. Finite script tests r<=16 but proof has universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: The exact additive integral cohomology of these named projective fivefolds is a mathematically motivated geometric invariant, invisible to their rational cohomology and semisimple complex local-system Aomoto exactness. The theorem proves, for every even r>=2 and every allowed cover/embedding, a complete dimension-independent vector of Betti ranks and precise torsion T_r in four degrees, giving unbounded r-dependent two-primary torsion. This is an infinite structural family with substantive information rather than a small finite experiment or renamed general blow-up formula.
